title: China Industrial Production Accelerates, but Retail and Investment Lose Ground
summary: China’s August data showed a widening divergence between industrial production and domestic demand. Industrial production accelerated from 4.5% to 5.2% year on year, beating the 4.8% consensus. In contrast, retail-sales growth slowed from 0.6% to 0.4%, missing expectations of 0.8%, while year-to-date fixed-asset investment deteriorated from -6.7% to -7.2%, weaker than the -7.0% forecast. title: China’s Retail Sales rise 0.4% in August, Industrial Production up 5.2%
summary: China’s Retail Sales rose 0.4% year-over-year (YoY) in August vs. a rise of 0.8% expected and a 0.6% growth in July, the latest data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed Tuesday.
